title: Commentary on Genesis (Eclogarum in libros historicos VT epitome, pt. 1) / «Толкование на Бытие»
author: Procopius of Gaza
edition: Metzler, GCS NF 22 (2015), with German translation (2016); Exodus volume 2020. PG 87.1 has a mainly Latin version.
ru_evidence: Procopius of Gaza is absent from the azbyka.ru author directory; no Russian translation found
en_evidence: Open Library lists editions and translations in Latin, Greek, German, French and Italian only; en.wikipedia cites only Metzler (German)
value: The earliest Greek catena-commentary. Preserves exegetical fragments of Philo, Origen, Eusebius of Emesa, Didymus and Theodoret; central to the Gaza school, where classical rhetoric met Christian exegesis.
ai_feasibility: medium: compiled excerpts require identifying their sources.
